query: WITH req AS (SELECT job_id, min(sent_at) AS carded, bool_or(cardinality(photo_ids) > 0) AS photo FROM quotes.shown_card WHERE job_id = ANY($1) AND sent_at < $3 GROUP BY job_id HAVING min(sent_at) >= $2), got AS (SELECT r.photo, count(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.received_at < r.carded + interval '24 hours') AS day, extract(epoch FROM min(q.received_at) - r.carded) AS first FROM req r LEFT JOIN quotes.quote q ON q.job_id = r.job_id AND q.received_at < $3 GROUP BY r.job_id, r.carded, r.photo) SELECT count(*) AS "requests!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE day >= 1) AS "one!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE day >= 2) AS "two!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE day >= 3) AS "three!", round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY first))::bigint AS median, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY first))::bigint AS p75, count(*) FILTER (WHERE photo) AS "photo!" FROM got
